purpose: New separately declared no-ML dual identity census after rejected frozen child-image census v1. Distinguish self sys.executable file/path identity from retained OS process image. No Torch/Transformers/site/model/assets/download/install/network/provider/GPU calls. No retry/repair or historical eight-child attribution.
known_policy: Approved-known roles are exact retained PID+creation launcher/actual base interpreter/native cmd, with actual OS image path and frozen file hash verified per snapshot. Before native only launcher/actual known. Any other PID, including image-identical base Python or identified System32 processes, remains unapproved. Classification/identity success is not training authorization. training_permitted=false at every stage, no ML release command/file/code path exists.

cases.native_census_graceful: Authenticated stdlib worker held before native; take before_native census. Release only fixed native cmd identity control; verify direct native parent/OSimage/hash/job; hold and take after_native census. All extras remain unapproved but do not prohibit completing this observational census. Release cmd with nonempty done line, verify known launcher/worker/cmd normal0 and all retained handles exited/job0. Unknown exit codes preserved; census pass is not policy admission.
cases.injected_python_rejection: Same first2snapshots, then controlled additional frozen base-python -S helper with distinct nonce. Authenticate helper PID/creation/actual-worker ancestry. after_helper census uses unchanged known-role policy excluding helper. Explicit helper must have OS-image base path/hash and remain unapproved even with image identical to actual worker. Parent releases no helper/ML finish and terminates whole job with actual/native/helper live. All observed retained refs exited/job0.

identity_and_images: Reuse frozen suspended assign/resume WindowsJob, worker nonce identity, Toolhelp ancestry, live membership, fixed native cmd launch and verified cleanup unchanged. For each cached descendant retain native handle, creation and live job, query OS QueryFullProcessImageNameW, record basename/file SHA256/normalized-realpath SHA256/exact path matches/path classification and verify PID/creation again. Public artifacts omit actual local absolute image paths. System32 classification uses SystemRoot/System32 directory, independent of basename. File-path bytes are hashed at query time, not proof of loaded image/DLL integrity.
bounded_snapshot: Snapshot full cached descendant PID/parent relations through16levels from launcher; root+at most16descendants may receive OS queries. If count limit exceeded, retain full observed cached PID/parent rows, known roles queried first and remaining rows explicitly unqueried/error; depth/count/query errors fail case. Every queried unknown OS image/error retained, continue within fixed budget to other observed rows. Each stage records job count before/after vs observed count and requires both match for census completeness. Counts do not establish identity or continuous coverage. Missing/extra-to-expected roles do not grant workload approval. OS API/hash calls are synchronous and cannot be hard-preempted; check monotonic budget around stages and rows; late return fails acceptance.
freeze_execution: Root reviews exact protocol/new-source/dependency/executable hashes and both distinct role maps, writes implementation freeze with executables_sha256 keys launcher/base_python/native before exactly one fresh-output real suite. New-census preflight uses only guarded stdlib/mock tests, with no live census/process-measurement/model preflight. Existing repository regression tests may separately execute CPU tensor/tiny randomly initialized model checks and auditor-CLI subprocess checks; they are software validation, not this census or a pretrained training experiment. Two fixed cases20s each, suite45s, bounded stage5s and cleanup4s clamped to nonrenewable case/suite deadlines. No retry, result replacement, classification/allowlist changes or threshold tuning after results. Keep all failures and prior frozen files unchanged.
report: Full nonce/PIDcreation/parent/job/live/image per queried row; partial image basename/pathdigest before file-hash failure retained with sha=null/error. Exact known image hashes bound to freeze/CLI paths. Snapshot counts, retained process identities, case/suite clock spans, normal/termination/cleanup evidence. Parent permits only census controls; reported training_permitted alwaysfalse, model_loads/update0. Success means bounded census/cleanup controls only; no loader/training/overhead/memory/quality/production proof. Unknown-image error strings retain exception type/query phase/native error code only; unknown absolute paths embedded in OS/file exceptions are omitted. New self_receipt.self_executable exact four fields source=sys.executable/basename/sha256/normalized_path_sha256 plus per-owner expected roles. Top-level both fixed role maps. OS image rows remain independent retained-handle evidence. Worker self path is expected launcher and OS image expected base Python; no implicit self==OS assumption.
frozen_path_contract: implementation.executable_path_sha256 is an exact launcher/base_python/native map of opaque canonical normalized-realpath digests. Before creating any Job or child, producer compares the actual three CLI path digests and file hashes to the freeze, then copies the verified path map to the report. Self path and OS image each bind independently to their own fixed role in this map.
review_tool_contract: implementation.review_tools_sha256 binds the exact two protocol.review_tool_paths. Producer checks actual file bytes before any Job/child and records the verified map in report.review_tools_sha256, without importing or executing the auditor. The auditor independently reads and checks its own current source/test hashes. Root writes this freeze after all producer/auditor mock reviews and before the only real suite.
dual_identity_contract: Worker self sys.executable must match frozen launcher content and opaque normalized-realpath digest; actual retained OS image must independently match frozen base_python. Helper self path independently matches frozen base_python and retained OS image independently matches base_python. Each owner records explicit self_executable_expected_role and retained_os_image_expected_role. Do not require equality or difference between these two identities; same executable bytes across roles are permitted only when each role passes its own path/content contract. No runtime_executable_* aliases remain. Self path identity is a self-report, never OS image attestation.
